description: Unit: initialize a new entry with explicit default start and end times and verify its notes equal the work-item description, including exact whitespace preservation.
Unit: initialize a new entry without explicit default times and verify its notes equal the work-item description; repeat with a nullish description and verify an empty string.
Unit: initialize from an existing entry and verify its saved notes are preserved even when the work item has a different description.
Manual smoke: enter a work description on a ticket, select Add time, confirm Notes is prefilled, save without editing it, and confirm the saved time entry shows the same notes.
